Select exact IC50 activities for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251). Require compounds to have a canonical SMILES string and activities to have a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Use an INNER JOIN to compound_structures to enforce SMILES presence. For provenance, join docs from activities.doc_id and compound_records from activities.record_id. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
